【Let's Talk About Session 13: 4/29】

Welcome to Let's Talk About

★Topic: Migration and Identity

Migration shapes the identities of individuals and nations, blending cultures while creating unique challenges. Have you experienced migration personally, or do you know someone who has? How does it affect identity and belonging? Join us to discuss the cultural and personal impacts of migration and practice articulating complex ideas and experiences in English.

Date: April 29 (Tuesday)
Time: 12:15 - 13:15
Held Online (Google Meet; the link will be sent after registration)
